name: Product Hunt
description: A site where makers post new products and visitors vote and comment. A launch runs for a day, so prepare the page, images and first comment before you post.

name: Hacker News
description: A discussion site run by Y Combinator. A story titled Show HN is for something you made that people can try. Read the Show HN rules before you post.

name: AlternativeTo
description: A directory of software listed as alternatives to other software. Buyers search it by the product they want to replace.

name: SaaSHub
description: A directory of software products with alternatives and short reviews.

name: G2
description: A software review site. Buyers compare products by user reviews, and vendors can claim a profile for their product.

name: Trustpilot
description: A public review site for businesses. A page exists once a business has been reviewed, and the business can claim it.

name: Capterra
description: A business software directory and review site. Vendors can list a product and collect reviews.

name: BetaList
description: A site that lists startups before launch and collects early sign-ups.

name: Indie Hackers
description: A community of founders who share what they build, with product pages and discussion groups.

name: DevHunt
description: A launch site where developers discover and vote on new developer tools.

name: StackShare
description: A site where companies and developers list the tools they use. Developer products appear on tool pages and in alternatives.

name: Crunchbase
description: A database of companies, funding and people. Investors and journalists use it to look up startups.

name: TrustRadius
description: A software review site for business buyers.

name: GetApp
description: A business software directory with user reviews.

name: SourceForge
description: A long-running software hosting and download directory.

name: Reddit r/SideProject
description: A subreddit where people share projects they built. Read the community rules before posting, and expect questions in the thread.

name: DEV Community
description: A publishing site for developers. A post about how you built or use the product is indexed by search engines.

name: Hashnode
description: A blogging platform for developers that can run on your own domain.

name: Uneed
description: A launch site for new tools.

name: Peerlist
description: A network for professionals with a weekly launch section for projects.
